protocol: five paired repetition blocks; modes shuffled within each block

cedar_optimization.object_authorizer: exact-result cache (typed aggressive mode not on this route)

primary_timer: application-reported invocation wall clock after preparation
secondary_timers: application preparation and parent subprocess wall clock are retained separately
comparison_scope: same fixed 15 applications; each comparator enforces every filesystem, process, and network restriction it can express for the invocation
residual_comparator_gap: NoNo and APF/OpenShell do not mediate typed library operations as Cedar resource/action terminals; APF and NoNo input path grants are therefore host-resource approximations, not Argus semantic equivalence

timers.process_wall_ms: parent dispatch through process exit; includes NoNo activation or OpenShell exec transport; excludes APF sandbox creation and cleanup
timers.sandbox_preparation_ms: APF projection, fresh sandbox creation, policy admission, and output setup
timers.end_to_end_wall_ms: sandbox preparation plus dispatch/process plus confirmed sandbox deletion

nono.audit: disabled to match final Argus configuration
nono.rollback: disabled because Argus does not claim rollback
nono.network: deny by default; direct TCP permitted only on port 11434
nono.network_residual: the port grant cannot restrict destination host
nono.filesystem: code/runtime read-only; exact external inputs read-only; only the fresh trial directory writable

apf_openshell.sandbox_lifecycle: fresh sandbox per invocation; deletion confirmed
apf_openshell.input_binding: each projected policy grants only the current invocation's read-only inputs
apf_openshell.policy_semantics: official APF compiler/OpenShell projector; code/runtime read-only; private workspace writable; best-effort Landlock; local model relay only
apf_openshell.audit: OpenShell defaults retained; not included in application output
